test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 4'** i.e.** 'Available'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word to fill in the blank number 5 would be** "available".**
 
• **The context of the sentence** is talking about reduced fat dairy products as alternatives to regular dairy products for those concerned about weight gain.
 
• Hence, the word** "available" **is the most fitting choice because it indicates that these reduced fat products exist and can be accessed.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *There are so many myths about the negative impacts of milk on health. Changing how much milk you drink because of these myths may mean you are unnecessarily restricting this highly nutritious drink. Australians often restrict dairy foods when they try to lose weight believing them to be fattening. While dairy products naturally contain fat there are many reduced fat products **available.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here's why the other options are less appropriate:
 
 
• **"Inoperable"** - This is typically used to describe something that cannot be operated or something that cannot be treated by surgery. In this context, it doesn't make sense because we're talking about dairy products, not machinery or medical conditions.
 
• **"Deficient"** - This means lacking in some necessary quality or element. It's not suitable in this context because the sentence seems to emphasize the availability of reduced fat dairy products, not their deficiency.
 
• **"Durable" **- This refers to the ability to withstand wear, pressure, or damage. It's not the best fit for this context because we're discussing food products, not items that need to be resistant to wear and tear.
